attrs.prompt:
Resume the completion-gate hardening work. We paused mid-stream and pushed everything to the
branch `wip/completion-gate-hardening` (you should already be on it â confirm with `git branch --show-current`).

CONTEXT â read the work item first: `wipnote feature show feat-23821886` (its description holds the
full resume checklist). Background: Codex logged 4 completion-gate bugs on track trk-49c43b06. Three
are implemented + verified green and committed on this branch; one is untouched.

ALREADY DONE (committed on this branch, build/vet/test green incl the core/ module):
- feat-23821886: subagent maxTurns bumped in plugin/agents/*.md + regenerated packages/gemini-extension/agents/*.md.
- bug-58205bf3: noexec /tmp -> GOTMPDIR redirect (cmd/wipnote/gate_exec.go gateExecEnv/isLikelyNoexecFailure/gateTmpRemediation + platform splits).
- bug-c3c9278a: runManagedGate sets Setpgid + a watchdog that kills the process group on context cancel, plus a "running: ..." progress line.
- bug-35857288: LatestPassingGateRecordForWorkItem cross-session fallback in core/db/gate_records.go, with an immediate HEAD re-gate in validateCompletionGateRecord (check_gate_support.go).
All three are wired into the live `wipnote feature complete` path with passing tests.

ENVIRONMENT HAZARDS (critical â confirm whether they still apply in this Codespace before trusting them):
- /tmp may be noexec here. Before ANY go command, export an exec-capable, non-git temp dir whose path
  contains the string "wipnote" (core/daemon lease tests false-fail otherwise):
      export TMPDIR=$HOME/.gotest-tmp GOTMPDIR=$HOME/.gotest-tmp/wipnote-build && mkdir -p "$TMPDIR" "$GOTMPDIR"
- NEVER run `git stash` in this tree (it has silently destroyed uncommitted work before). Stage with
  explicit pathspecs; the installed `wipnote` binary may predate the hardening â run `wipnote build` before relying on the gate.

DO, IN ORDER:
1. Dead-code cleanup (go vet/build do NOT catch these): remove the unused `decodeGateAllowlistHits` in
   core/db/gate_records.go (confirm no callers first); use-or-remove the unused `name` param in
   `runManagedGate` (cmd/wipnote/gate_exec.go). Also check why cmd/wipnote/sqlite_write_boundary_test.go
   was modified and confirm it's intentional.
2. `wipnote build`, then run gates green: `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` AND `cd core && go test ./...`.
3. Commit the cleanup, then formally complete the three bugs (currently in-progress):
   `wipnote bug complete bug-58205bf3 && wipnote bug complete bug-c3c9278a && wipnote bug complete bug-35857288`.
   If the completion gate reports 0 linked commits despite committed code, try `wipnote ingest commits`
   then re-complete; use `--accepted-advisory` only as a last resort and say so.
4. THEN implement the still-open bug-36b696a5 (strict autocommit reopens the item when .git is read-only
   in a sandbox): fix in cmd/wipnote/workitem_commit.go (commitWipnoteArtifactStrict ~line 183) and
   cmd/wipnote/workitem.go (commitArtifactTransactional reopen path ~line 439) â detect the read-only-fs
   error up front and offer an explicit bypass/manual-commit path instead of unconditionally reopening.

Follow wipnote orchestration: delegate code edits to wipnote coder subagents, set the work item active
before any edits, and verify any cut-off subagent's work yourself (subagents here have truncated mid-task â
don't trust a coder's red/green claim without re-running gates).

attrs.user_prompt:
Resume the completion-gate hardening work. We paused mid-stream and pushed everything to the
branch `wip/completion-gate-hardening` (you should already be on it â confirm with `git branch --show-current`).

CONTEXT â read the work item first: `wipnote feature show feat-23821886` (its description holds the
full resume checklist). Background: Codex logged 4 completion-gate bugs on track trk-49c43b06. Three
are implemented + verified green and committed on this branch; one is untouched.

ALREADY DONE (committed on this branch, build/vet/test green incl the core/ module):
- feat-23821886: subagent maxTurns bumped in plugin/agents/*.md + regenerated packages/gemini-extension/agents/*.md.
- bug-58205bf3: noexec /tmp -> GOTMPDIR redirect (cmd/wipnote/gate_exec.go gateExecEnv/isLikelyNoexecFailure/gateTmpRemediation + platform splits).
- bug-c3c9278a: runManagedGate sets Setpgid + a watchdog that kills the process group on context cancel, plus a "running: ..." progress line.
- bug-35857288: LatestPassingGateRecordForWorkItem cross-session fallback in core/db/gate_records.go, with an immediate HEAD re-gate in validateCompletionGateRecord (check_gate_support.go).
All three are wired into the live `wipnote feature complete` path with passing tests.

ENVIRONMENT HAZARDS (critical â confirm whether they still apply in this Codespace before trusting them):
- /tmp may be noexec here. Before ANY go command, export an exec-capable, non-git temp dir whose path
  contains the string "wipnote" (core/daemon lease tests false-fail otherwise):
      export TMPDIR=$HOME/.gotest-tmp GOTMPDIR=$HOME/.gotest-tmp/wipnote-build && mkdir -p "$TMPDIR" "$GOTMPDIR"
- NEVER run `git stash` in this tree (it has silently destroyed uncommitted work before). Stage with
  explicit pathspecs; the installed `wipnote` binary may predate the hardening â run `wipnote build` before relying on the gate.

DO, IN ORDER:
1. Dead-code cleanup (go vet/build do NOT catch these): remove the unused `decodeGateAllowlistHits` in
   core/db/gate_records.go (confirm no callers first); use-or-remove the unused `name` param in
   `runManagedGate` (cmd/wipnote/gate_exec.go). Also check why cmd/wipnote/sqlite_write_boundary_test.go
   was modified and confirm it's intentional.
2. `wipnote build`, then run gates green: `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` AND `cd core && go test ./...`.
3. Commit the cleanup, then formally complete the three bugs (currently in-progress):
   `wipnote bug complete bug-58205bf3 && wipnote bug complete bug-c3c9278a && wipnote bug complete bug-35857288`.
   If the completion gate reports 0 linked commits despite committed code, try `wipnote ingest commits`
   then re-complete; use `--accepted-advisory` only as a last resort and say so.
4. THEN implement the still-open bug-36b696a5 (strict autocommit reopens the item when .git is read-only
   in a sandbox): fix in cmd/wipnote/workitem_commit.go (commitWipnoteArtifactStrict ~line 183) and
   cmd/wipnote/workitem.go (commitArtifactTransactional reopen path ~line 439) â detect the read-only-fs
   error up front and offer an explicit bypass/manual-commit path instead of unconditionally reopening.

Follow wipnote orchestration: delegate code edits to wipnote coder subagents, set the work item active
before any edits, and verify any cut-off subagent's work yourself (subagents here have truncated mid-task â
don't trust a coder's red/green claim without re-running gates).
